title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

£40,000 - £60,000

London (3 days a week)

This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading customer experience and marketing analytics consultancy where data is at the heart of decision-making. You'll work closely with a major consumer brand, helping shape marketing strategy through experimentation, customer analytics, and actionable insights that drive measurable business outcomes.

THE COMPANY

They are an established analytics and customer experience consultancy that partners with well-known consumer brands to improve customer engagement, marketing effectiveness, and commercial performance. Their Marketing Science function brings together analytics, data science, and business strategy to help clients make smarter, data-driven decisions.

The business offers clear progression opportunities, a collaborative culture, and the chance to work across a variety of analytics disciplines over time. Employees are encouraged to develop broad expertise while building specialist knowledge in areas that interest them most.

THE ROLE

As a Data Analyst, you will as part of a Marketing Science team supporting a major retail client, delivering insights that influence customer and marketing decisions.

Specifically, you can expect to be involved in the following:

  • Designing, delivering, and analysing marketing experiments and test-and-learn programmes
  • Evaluating campaign performance and providing recommendations for future activity
  • Conducting customer journey analysis to identify opportunities for growth and optimisation
  • Using SQL and/or Python to extract, manipulate, and analyse data
  • Building reports, dashboards, and insight presentations for stakeholders
  • Working with digital analytics tools to answer business questions and generate actionable insights
  • Collaborating with strategy, technology, and client teams on a range of analytical projects
  • Applying statistical techniques to support commercial decision-making and performance measurement
  • Supporting data collection, tracking, and measurement frameworks

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

The successful Data Analyst will have the following skills and experience:

  • Strong SQL and/or Python skills
  • Experience within customer analytics, marketing analytics, CRM analytics, product analytics, or a similar analytical discipline
  • Proven experience designing, running, and evaluating experiments, including A/B testing or broader test-and-learn methodologies
  • Strong statistical and analytical problem-solving skills
  • Experience translating data into clear commercial recommendations
  • Exposure to campaign analysis, customer journey analytics, segmentation, or marketing effectiveness measurement
  • Retail, ecommerce, consumer, or broader B2C experience would be beneficial

BENEFITS

The successful Data Analyst will receive the following benefits:

  • Salary between £40,000 - £60,000 - depending on experience

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your resume to Majid Latif via the Apply link on this page.
